decisions.reason: The UV spot varnishing system is a flagship premiered at a customer event, and enhancement equipment needs several years to build an installed base, so it stays despite being distant from the core.
The sheet preparation module adds to existing modular systems at low cost and supports sales of connected finishing lines.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship that fits the firm's automation and digital-finishing direction squarely.
The hybrid saddle stitcher serves the core booklet-making business for short-run digital printers.
The folding add-on unit has a documented customer installation and complements the established Multigraf systems.
